analysis.headline: Shares Your Info Extensively
analysis.quote: We may share personal information with our business partners, which may include information shared for the purposes of marketing or interest-based advertising.

analysis.headline: Shares with Corporate Affiliates
analysis.quote: We may share personal information with our corporate affiliates and subsidiaries, who process personal information on our behalf as our vendor, where necessary to provide a product or service that you have requested or in other circumstances with your consent or as permitted or required by law.

analysis.headline: Shares Data with List Renters
analysis.quote: We also make certain information about our print magazine subscribers available for list renters to engage in direct, physical mail marketing, but in such circumstances, no personal information is actually made available to the renter.

analysis.headline: Shares with Data Co-ops
analysis.quote: Forbes also shares certain personal information about its subscribers and visitors with other publishers in connection with data co-ops.

analysis.headline: Your Editorial Content is Public
analysis.quote: Moreover, be aware that if you provide personal information that is published in our editorial content, this information will become publicly available and may be shared with third parties for any purpose permitted by law.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Precise Location
analysis.quote: Geolocation or other information that permits us to determine your location.

analysis.headline: Tracks You Across Devices
analysis.quote: We may use information we have collected to help us, or our third-party vendors and advertising partners, determine if you have interacted with our Properties across multiple devices and to match such devices.

analysis.headline: Your Data Transferred Globally
analysis.quote: If you submit personal information to Forbes, your personal information may be processed in a foreign country where privacy laws may be less stringent than the laws in your country.

analysis.headline: Your Usage Equals Agreement
analysis.quote: BY USING OR ACCESSING THE PROPERTIES OR OUR SERVICES, YOU AGREE TO THIS PRIVACY STATEMENT.
